title: Sense Embeddings are also Biased – Evaluating Social Biases in Static and Contextualised Sense Embeddings

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating pseudo log-likelihood scores of masked language models on stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical sentences using noun and verb senses of occupations (SSSB dataset), and measuring cosine similarity of embeddings against gender directional vectors (WAT dataset).

Comparing pseudo log-likelihood scores of sentences that distinguish the racial sense of the word 'black' from its colour sense, associating them with pleasant or unpleasant attributes (SSSB dataset).

Comparing pseudo log-likelihood scores of sentences that distinguish the nationality sense of ambiguous words (e.g., 'Japanese people') from their language sense (e.g., 'Japanese language'), associating them with pleasant or unpleasant attributes (SSSB dataset).
